## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::GovernanceSignerSetEmpty` — the signer set is empty.

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Provide at least two distinct signer addresses to `governance_bootstrap`; an empty set cannot govern.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#2-governance-failure-modes-and-mitigations`](../../docs/POLICY_GOVERNANCE.md#2-governance-failure-modes-and-mitigations)
